description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView component in Android that displays log data. It implements the LogNode interface, formatting and appending log entries based on their priority, tag, message, and exception details, and supports chaining to other LogNode instances.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for displaying log data, implementing LogNode interface, providing log formatting, display, and chaining capabilities.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors for LogView with various parameter options.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data and updates the LogView display; also forwards to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append non-null strings to a StringBuilder with delimiters.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView display.
